يستلب (form VIII)
# يَسْتَلِبُ (yastalibu) /jas.ta.li.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# يُسْتَلَبُ (yustalabu) /jus.ta.la.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# يَسْتَلِبَ (yastaliba) /jas.ta.li.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
